correctness.rationale: For each of the eight sign choices the three-equality projector (1+uv+uw+vw)/4 is exact. Removing each unit position by complete inclusion-exclusion gives the displayed Dirichlet convolution formula. Its local prime-power factors are computed explicitly using f(p^j)=-1 for j>=1. Constructive support partitions prove all non-exceptions, while prime-factor count and parity exclude all listed families. Classical fixed-order Landau estimates give the leading exceptional count. verify.py independently enumerates 2508 n values including all n<=2500; these finite checks only corroborate the proof.

value.rationale: The work completely resolves a natural higher-order monochromatic product question for the canonical parity-of-prime-support coloring. It supplies full ordered factor multiplicities on every integer, a sharp structural boundary at squarefree four-prime products, and the leading exceptional-density asymptotic; individual binary-product density or unrestricted ordered-factorization counts cannot recover these refinements. It is a modest self-contained arithmetic classification, not a general arbitrary-coloring breakthrough.
